scope: Personal data processed in the course of commercial transactions within Grenada
applies_to: Public and private bodies (Information Commission advises both); processing in commercial transactions within Grenada
key_requirements: Rights of access, rectification, notice and choice (consent), disclosure, retention limits, security and data integrity; exemptions for law enforcement and journalistic, literary or artistic purposes. "Seven principles" not confirmed
penalties_range: Individuals: up to EC$50,000 or 3 years (summary), up to EC$100,000 or 5 years (indictable); corporate bodies: up to EC$250,000 (summary), EC$500,000 (indictable)
notes: Commencement by ministerial Gazette order; none located and a 2026 government document reportedly describes the framework as not in force; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
